title: Classification metrics protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Classification metrics should complete this objective: Calculate accuracy, precision, and recall. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Interpret classification performance.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Explain the error trade-off for the chosen classification task.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score and does not run the learner code. Explain the error trade-off for the chosen classification task.
